headline: Phinma Properties Secures P1.8 Billion China Bank Loan for Bacolod Project
summary: Phinma Properties obtained P1.8 billion in debt financing from China Banking Corp. to develop its masterplanned township in Bacolod City.
why: China Banking Corp. is one of the premier commercial banks in the Philippines funding regional real estate developments.

impacts.name: China Banking Corp
impacts.why: China Bank provided P1.8 billion in township development financing.
